policies.dashboard_display_order: Use each dashboard record display_order only when listing the directory. Order does not select sources,rank credibility,authorize retrieval or establish fallback preference.
policies.evidence: Select evidence by the claim: relevant public contract state/events for contract-derived quantities,official publications for documented terms,and appropriately scoped data for other questions. Dashboards receive no default or fallback priority from directory order; use them when explicitly requested or their specific evidence is relevant,under the same provenance,freshness and completeness checks.
policies.freshness: Treat displayed figures as dated observations. Disclose unavailable, stale, incomplete, or differently defined data from any source.
policies.missing_review_dates: A missing reviewed_on or observed_on is an unknown/unrecorded content-review date, not an implied September 10 baseline date. Link-only and not-reviewed records must not be presented as reviewed. Record a new dated review only after actually inspecting the source, preserving earlier publication and observation dates separately.
policies.interviews: Preserve all original source posts, including later discoveries. Do not invent titles, guests, dates, transcripts, or conclusions before reviewing the material. Attribute reviewed claims to speakers and retain recording timestamps where available.
policies.intake_completeness: Every supplied URL is retained below. A catalogued URL is not evidence that its content has been reviewed.
policies.explorer_navigation: Robinhood Etherscan is the default object-link provider for Robinhood Chain, including historical objects, not an exclusive research or citation provider. Use assets/address-conventions.json templates after validating chain and full address/transaction hash; market IDs are neither. Suitable alternative explorers, RPCs and original evidence URLs may be researched and cited. Preserve original URLs, dates and attribution. Provider API listing is not permission, credentials or guaranteed method coverage.
policies.privacy: Do not distribute private RPC credentials, authenticated URLs, or personal portfolio notes in the portable skill.
